description: This file defines a React functional component named AddNote, which provides a user interface for adding notes with a character limit. It manages local state for the note text and handles user input and save actions.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles input change in the textarea, updating the note text state if within character limit.

methods.name: handleSaveClick
methods.description: Invokes the handleAddNote callback with the current note text and resets the input field.
